_doc: XFN (cross-functional) skills imported from their fbcode source-of-truth into the OT MyClaw's local skill load path. fbcode is canonical; the agent-market/claude-templates marketplace is a downstream snapshot that can lag (newly-landed components take hours-to-days to roll out), so we copy from fbcode directly and re-sync. Follows the mvai-skill management pattern. Add a skill = add one row here + re-run tools/sync-xfn-skills.sh.

skills.name: ot-reliability-health-check
skills.why: OT reliability health check: job uptime, training throughput, checkpoint cadence, snapshot freshness, streaming health. Migrated from skill-sources.json (ot-ingest-gdocs Part 2) 2026-06-17.

skills.name: hedwig-oncall
skills.why: OT publish-path debug: streaming staleness, flow-control throttling, delivery-rate drops, FlowTracker rate decision. Drives the chronic example-age lag investigation.

skills.name: model-processing-freshness-reliability
skills.why: Query APS+IEN publish success rates (full snapshot, sparse delta, dense delta) via Scuba. Used when OT freshness SLO is degraded to identify which publish path is failing.

skills.name: model-processing-freshness-latency
skills.why: Query P50/P99 publish latency for APS+IEN via Scuba. Used during ATS spike or model-age SLO breach to identify whether latency or reliability is the bottleneck.

skills.name: ip-runtime-debugging-model-freshness
skills.why: Reproduce and debug Sigrid Predictor snapshot loading: inplace update, delta/streaming updates, snapshot transitions. Covers the serving-side of the OT pipeline (publisher -> predictor load).

skills.name: ip-runtime-recsys-inference-sev-review
skills.why: SEV investigation for RecSys inference serving stack (Sigrid Predictor, IPNext, GPU runtime). Used when a freshness SEV or ATS regression may be rooted in the predictor/serving layer rather than the training/publish pipeline.

skills.name: ip-runtime-sev-team-analysis
skills.why: Analyze SEVs for Runtime Team ownership and root cause attribution. Used when triaging whether an OT incident is in-lane (MRS) vs predictor/runtime team domain.
